items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Russell Bowells was with Jimmy Lunceford... brought to a tremendous peak by Goodman and Artie Shaw and the Dorseys and Jimmy Lunceford

ctx.x: Oh, a great guitarist. Thigpen on drums, Ed Thigpen's father.
And Ben on drums. Oh, Andy Kirk had a great band. I can't think of his trombone player's name, I think it was Russell Bowells, but Russell Bowells was with Jimmy Lunceford.
He was with Lunceford's band, yes he was.
